podcast.title: 8-Bit Computer Music Style
podcast.body: Chiptunes is a genre where musicians adapt existing songs or create new ones to emulate the sound of 8-bit computer music, giving them a retro, digital aesthetic. "We have something that sometimes called chiptunes, where people take songs and rewrite them so they sound like 8-bit computer music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
